not_implemented_or_not_established: NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for a reader's opinion written as prose (CONFORMANCE E07). A draft whose text says the argument 'looks correct, so the result can be treated as verified', with gaps emptied, passes all eight layers. The draft carries no verdict field, but nothing stops that sentence from later being quoted as support. Declared as unchecked.opinion_as_support and asserted as passing in tests/test_interfaces.py::test_known_gap_opinion_text_passes.

NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for a business record smuggled as prose (CONFORMANCE E05). The anti-smuggling scan walks JSON structure only; a complete record serialised into a text string passes. Verified by running the checker on such a draft.

NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for turning an unknown into a denial or a success (CONFORMANCE E11), for example 'no counterexample was found, therefore the claim holds'. Explanation text is never read at all (unchecked.explanation_quality).
NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for a silently dropped gap (CONFORMANCE E12). Declared gaps are counted, never compared with the open items of the explained records (unchecked.gap_fidelity).

NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for an untrue attribution (CONFORMANCE E04, second half). The declared UNESTABLISHED or SELF_CHECK value is taken as given; whether the same principal produced the explained material is a host fact this checker does not have (unchecked.attribution). Note that reader is not in validate.py's independent set, so a reader Task is not required to declare exclusions either.
Whether an explanation is correct, readable, matched to its stated audience, or an answer to the brief at all is not checked anywhere in this module.
INVISIBLE_REF and UNEXPLAINED_TARGET only run when --task is supplied. The same draft citing a record the Task never provided passes when the checker is run without a Task.

The checker never verifies that any referenced record exists, and never verifies that a follow-up request names all the inputs its target operation requires; both are the scheduler's and the host's responsibility.
No RecordSet, stored envelope, content hash, root record constraint or reference closure is checked; source bytes and provenance are not checked; no Result, delivery outcome or approval is produced.
No assembler, manifest writer, Result generator or delivery channel exists for this module. INTERFACE.md section 5 is a contract for those, not a description of running code.
Cross-model readability cases L-01 to L-04 in ../PENDING_TESTS.md have not been executed. A checker exit 0 says nothing about whether a reader could follow the explanation.
The conformance fixtures are synthetic: their record ids and content hashes do not correspond to any stored record, and the Task fixtures were hand-built rather than issued by a host.
The six conformance commands in CONFORMANCE.md section 5 are not wired into ../tests/run_agent_tests.py; only the pytest suite is. Wiring them requires editing a file this module does not own.

Running pytest across the whole package requires --import-mode=importlib, because this module's tests/test_interfaces.py shares a basename with Autoformalization Agent's and neither tests directory has an __init__.py. Without the flag, collection aborts at exit 2.

AGENT.md was left unchanged this round and now understates the module. Its status line says the checker source exists but was not run in that round, and section 6 says no checker or cross-model case is executed; as of this report the checker is wired into run_agent_tests.py as step reader-pytest and 42 tests pass. AGENT.md also does not link INTERFACE.md or CONFORMANCE.md, because both postdate it.

AGENT.md front-matter uses operation / execution-kind / business-contract / orchestration-overlay / draft-version, while Paper Agent and Autoformalization Agent use applies-to-business-contract / applies-to-orchestration-overlay / <kind>-draft-version. The two spellings were not unified, and AGENT.md carries no I1-I6 landing table.
